anomaly_1_cycle_eval_no_gpu.description: cycle_eval.sh runs `eval/score.py --out RESULT` as a 'cache-only local pass' on whatever node it's invoked from. On the login node (no GPU), score.py cannot hit the cache for newly-built families and tries to run them locally, where each fno_* family training hits the per_call_timeout_seconds=1800 limit (~3h wall total for 6 fno × dataset pairs). This was observed during the evaluator agent's invocation and during a later CEO sanity test.
anomaly_1_cycle_eval_no_gpu.impact: When the local pass runs WITHOUT a parallel SLURM job, the cache-miss path silently dominates and smoke_latest.json gets written with timeout entries for the in-tree fno_* families, producing a degraded composite_nRMSE.
anomaly_1_cycle_eval_no_gpu.workaround_used_this_cycle: R0 was run as an explicit sbatch (SLURM job 15313689) on partition=mit_preemptable. That job populated the cache files in results/raw/ correctly. The corrupted smoke_latest.json from the local-pass race was restored from results/history.jsonl entry [18] (ts=1780362381) before this summary.json was finalized.
anomaly_1_cycle_eval_no_gpu.operator_action_required: Either (a) make cycle_eval.sh gate the local pass on `nvidia-smi` succeeding, (b) lower per_call_timeout_seconds in smoke_config.json from 1800 → ~60, or (c) route everything through SLURM regardless of cache state. All three live in fixed surfaces (scripts/, eval/), so a Builder cannot fix them — operator must edit.

anomaly_2_smoke_latest_was_overwritten_a.remediation: smoke_latest.json now correctly reflects the SLURM-produced composite_nRMSE = 0.033726 as of cycle-005 R0 finalization.
